license_required.quote: No individual, firm, association or corporation shall act as an adjuster in this State unless authorized to do so by virtue of a license issued or renewed pursuant to this act.

issuing_authority.quote: The commissioner may issue a public adjuster's license to any individual, firm, association or corporation

name.quote: The commissioner may issue a public adjuster's license to any individual, firm, association or corporation

moral_character_required.quote: who, or which, is trustworthy and competent to act as an adjuster in a manner as to safeguard the interests of the people of this State

required.quote: The commissioner may require an applicant for a license to present evidence, in the form he may prescribe, that the applicant has been employed for a period which he deems reasonable, by an insurer, an independent adjuster or a public adjuster

experience_source.quote: The commissioner may require an applicant for a license to present evidence, in the form he may prescribe, that the applicant has been employed for a period which he deems reasonable, by an insurer, an independent adjuster or a public adjuster

exams.name: Written examination
exams.notes: Commissioner may dispense with examination for applicants holding a substantially similar out-of-state license or who previously operated a public adjusting business in NJ.
exams.jurisdiction: state (commissioner-administered, may contract with private vendors)
exams.quote: The commissioner shall require every individual applicant and each sublicensee to take and pass a written examination to his satisfaction, except in the case of a renewal license, in order to determine the competency of the applicant or sublicensee to act as a public adjuster.

interval_years.quote: Every adjuster's license issued pursuant to this act may be renewed for a two-year period upon the filing of an application in conformity with section 6 of this act

required.quote: The commissioner shall require every individual licensed as a public adjuster, and each sublicensee of a licensed adjuster that is a corporation, firm or association, as a condition of biennial license renewal pursuant to this section, to complete not less than 15 hours of continuing education.

hours_per_period.quote: to complete not less than 15 hours of continuing education. Each hour of instruction shall be equivalent to one credit.

period_years.quote: Every adjuster's license issued pursuant to this act may be renewed for a two-year period

available.quote: holds a license as a public adjuster issued by another state in which the licensing provisions of public adjusters are substantially similar to the provisions of this act and which similarly recognizes and accepts public adjusters licensed in New Jersey

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a public adjuster license from another state with substantially similar licensing provisions that similarly recognizes NJ-licensed public adjusters; commissioner may waive examination requirement.

title_protection.quote: No insurer's representative and no licensed insurance producer shall advertise or publicly solicit the adjustment of claims in a manner likely to mislead the public into believing that he is offering his services as a public adjuster.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provision of the insurance law, including commissioner rules, or any law in the course of dealings as an adjuster.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated any provision of the insurance law, including any rules promulgated by the commissioner, or has violated any law in the course of his, or its, dealings as an adjuster

disciplinary_grounds.description: Withheld material information or made a material misstatement in the license application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has withheld material information or made a material misstatement in the application for the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed a fraudulent or dishonest act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed a fraudulent or dishonest act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetency, lack of integrity, bad faith, dishonesty, financial irresponsibility, or untrustworthiness to act as an adjuster.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has demonstrated his, or its, incompetency, lack of integrity, bad faith, dishonesty, financial irresponsibility or untrustworthiness to act as an adjuster

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aided, abetted, or assisted another person in violating any insurance law of this State.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has aided, abetted or assisted another person in violating any insurance law of this State.

bonding_required.quote: No adjuster's license or renewal license shall be issued to an applicant unless there shall be on file with the commissioner a bond, executed by the applicant and by approved sureties, in the penal sum of $10,000

definition_quote.value: any individual, firm, association or corporation who, or which, for money, commission or any other thing of value, acts or aids in any manner on behalf of an insured in negotiating for, or effecting, the settlement of claims for loss of damage caused by, or resulting from, any accident, incident, or occurrence covered under a property insurance policy, including, but not limited to, a flood, transit, inland marine or ocean marine policy; or who, or which, advertises for, or solicits employment as an adjuster of those claims.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: A license issued to a corporation may name as sublicensees only the officers and directors of the corporation, and a license issued to a firm or association may name as sublicensees only the individual members of the firm or association.

fingerprint_background_check_required.quote: fingerprints of his two hands taken on standard fingerprint cards by a State or municipal law enforcement agency

surety_bond_required.quote: No adjuster's license or renewal license shall be issued to an applicant unless there shall be on file with the commissioner a bond, executed by the applicant and by approved sureties, in the penal sum of $10,000

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: a bond, executed by the applicant and by approved sureties, in the penal sum of $10,000 applicable to the licensee and each of the sublicensees named in the license.

written_contract_required.quote: A public adjuster shall not, directly or indirectly, act within this State as a public adjuster without having first entered into a contract, in writing, and executed in duplicate by the public adjuster and the insured.

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: The insured may cancel this contract before midnight of the third business day after signing the contract without further obligation

catastrophe_solicitation_prohibited.quote: No individual, firm, association or corporation licensed under P.L.1993, c.66 (C.17:22B-1 et al.) shall: a. solicit the adjustment of a loss or damage occurring in this State from an insured, whether by personal interview, by telephone, or by any other method, between the hours of 6:00 p.m. and 8:00 a.m. during the 24 hours after the loss has occurred

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: be liable to a civil penalty of not more than $2,500 for the first offense and not more than $5,000 for the second and each subsequent offense.
